name: youtube-transcript
description: Fetches existing YouTube subtitles (manual or auto-generated) via the InnerTube API and returns them as plain text, SRT, or VTT. Does not perform speech-to-text or video/audio download — only retrieves captions YouTube already publishes.

tools.name: list_transcript_tracks
tools.description: List a video's caption tracks (language, manual/auto, estimated character count) without fetching any track's content

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Fetch a video's transcript as text (default), srt, or vtt, with cursor-based pagination for long transcripts
